Ball Ground among 42 cities tied at 81st in Georgia for July scam reports
N. A. Ortega
Ball Ground was one of 42 cities tied at 81st among 218 Georgia cities with at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in July 2026, logging two scam reports, according to Better Business Bureau.
That was up from one report in the previous month.
One report in July 2026 included a dollar amount, totaling $239.94 in reported losses. The most common category was online purchase, with one report.
BBB Scam Tracker allows consumers to search reported scams and share their experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to carry large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
